definitions.explanation: Using money, time, or resources carelessly or on unnecessary things.

examples.japanese: {無駄遣|むだづか}いをやめて{貯金|ちょきん}する。
examples.english: To stop wasteful spending and start saving.

examples.japanese: それは{時間|じかん}の{無駄遣|むだづか}いだ。
{税金|ぜいきん}の{無駄遣|むだづか}いをなくすべきだ。
examples.english: We should eliminate wasteful spending of tax money.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{無駄|むだ} (waste, uselessness) + {遣|つか}い (use, spending) → wasteful use = squandering

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{無駄遣|むだづか}いをする - to waste (money, time, etc.)
・{無駄遣|むだづか}いをやめる - to stop wasting
・{時間|じかん}の{無駄遣|むだづか}い - waste of time
・{税金|ぜいきん}の{無駄遣|むだづか}い - wasteful spending of taxes
・お{金|かね}の{無駄遣|むだづか}い - wasteful spending of money

NUANCE:
Can apply to money, time, energy, resources, or talent. Often used critically when someone or something (like the government) is perceived as spending carelessly.
